_comment: Rollout knob for the MD-first write-time gate (check-md-first.mjs, md-first-gate.sh). Fires on PreToolUse Edit|Write|NotebookEdit for clients/*/tests/**/*.spec.ts writes. off = gate disabled; announce = allows the write but emits a warning + appends fire telemetry (warn-only, ramp default); deny = blocks the write + appends fire telemetry. Every deny/announce verdict appends one line to .claude/state/gate-fires.log (gate, ISO timestamp, verdict, target-path). Read by check-md-first.mjs readGateMode(); MD_FIRST_MODE env overrides in tests. Ramp to deny per Phase 3.3 discipline: never straight to deny for S1 — land at announce, ramp after zero false positives for N clean sessions, record flip in ramp_flipped.
_provenance: PLAN_REACTIVE_VS_PREVENTIVE_GUARDRAIL_AUDIT Phase 2 Step 2. Sev=S1 per §3.1 rubric (silent quality drift surviving to commit/ship — MD↔spec parity drift). Graduating incident: 2026-07-08 MD↔XLSX↔spec parity slip (commit 664ae0cc; TC IDs written to spec with no MD source row via --no-verify). Landed announce per Phase 3.3 ramp discipline (S1: announce on first, deny on second confirmed recurrence). One shared guardrail-config.json, not one file per gate (Phase 3.3 mandate).
ramp_note: Flip md_first_mode to 'deny' after 5 clean sessions with zero false positives and zero announce fires for genuinely-absent IDs. Record flip date in ramp_flipped and set ramp_complete to true.
_mistake_ledger_comment: Rollout knob for the mistake-ledger Stop-hook gate (check-mistake-ledger.mjs, mistake-ledger-gate.sh). Fires on Stop events for mutating sessions that end with no mistake attestation. off = gate disabled; announce = warns + persists state entry (mode=announce, verdict floor YELLOW) + telemetry warn; deny = escalation mode: same as announce (non-veto per Stop-hook nature — LR-060) but persists mode=deny in state entry (floors verdict to RED) and emits warn-deny in telemetry; unknown value fails SAFE to announce. Sev=S1 per §3.1 rubric (silent omission of session mistake record surviving to session end). Graduating incident: 2026-07-10 owner directive — /reflect + /final-q prose mandate is Tier-3 (weakest layer) without a structural backstop. Landed announce per Phase 3.3 ramp discipline (S1: announce on first, deny on second confirmed recurrence). Rule body: LR-069 §3.2 in .claude/rules/guardrail-policy.md.
mistake_ledger_ramp_note: promote to deny after 10 consecutive mutating sessions end attested with zero false-positive warnings (stale mid-session warning files cleared on attestation do not count as fires). deny is non-veto per LR-060 (Stop hooks cannot block); it floors the verdict to RED and emits warn-deny in telemetry vs YELLOW/warn for announce.

Its uplink-fire helper hardcodes the literal 'announce' (wrapper line ~151) and no 'enforce' code path exists. Do not trust uplink_ramp_target below until that lands. Surfaced by a cross-family gap-hunt debate; ranking + evidence in the delegation decision-debates.jsonl (2026-07-13 entry). _uplink_comment: Rollout knob for the uplink consult machinery (UPLINK_DOCTRINE §2 calibration ≡ LR-069 ramp; wires in the dispatch wrapper UW-1..4 + .claude/hooks/lib/uplink/*.mjs; HARD policy in ~/.claude/delegation/uplink-policy.json). announce = trip-wires log CONSULT-WOULD-FIRE to uplink.log + gate-fires.log, NOTHING is killed/consulted/injected; enforce = wires actually fire consults + inject binding advisories; off = disabled. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1 (assumption-leak survives to ship). Graduating incident: Rutvik owner directive 2026-07-12 — agents assume, managers miss it, assumption failures leak to the deliverable uncaught. Rule body: LR-070 in .claude/rules/guardrail-policy.md. Every fire appends one CSV line to .claude/state/gate-fires.log.
uplink_ramp_note: Phase 7 (PLAN_UPLINK_PROTOCOL) is a separate future session by design. Flip uplink_mode to 'enforce' ONLY after: >=20 announce-mode dispatches logged; trip-rate lands in the 10-20%-of-decision-points band (doctrine §2); zero false CONSULT-WOULD-FIRE on runs that ended green without help; budgets never breached by logging alone. Trip-rate >20% => fix tickets/harness FIRST, do not arm. Record ramp_flipped date + set uplink_ramp_complete true on flip.

Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1 (silent quality drift — depth checks skipped without gate). Graduating incident: LR-062 opt-in precedent — gate existed but nobody flipped it, indistinguishable from no gate at all. Ramp deadline enforced by scripts/check-ramp-expiry.mjs.
depth_gate_ramp_note: Promote depth_gate_mode to 'deny' after zero false positives across 5 clean sessions with the walk-depth gate active. Record ramp_flipped date and set depth_gate_ramp_complete to true on flip.
_reject_oracle_comment: Rollout knob for the reject-oracle gate (PLAN_WALK_DEPTH_GATE Phase 6). announce = oracle rejections are logged but do not block; promote to deny after ramp criterion is met. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1. Ramp deadline enforced by scripts/check-ramp-expiry.mjs.
reject_oracle_ramp_note: Promote reject_oracle_mode to 'deny' after the reject-oracle gate fires at least 3 times with zero false positives. Record ramp_flipped date and set reject_oracle_ramp_complete to true on flip.
_toothless_surface_comment: Rollout knob for the toothless-surface detection gate (PLAN_WALK_DEPTH_GATE Phase 6). announce = surface defects are reported but do not block; promote to deny after ramp criterion is met. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1. Ramp deadline enforced by scripts/check-ramp-expiry.mjs.
toothless_surface_ramp_note: Promote toothless_surface_mode to 'deny' after toothless-surface detection lands with zero false positives across 5 clean sessions. Record ramp_flipped date and set toothless_surface_ramp_complete to true on flip.
_unresolved_probe_comment: Rollout knob for the unresolved-probe gate (PLAN_UNIQUE_CASE_COVERAGE_FLOOR Phase 1). announce = unresolved probes are reported but do not block; promote to deny after ramp criterion is met. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1. Ramp deadline enforced by scripts/check-ramp-expiry.mjs.
unresolved_probe_ramp_note: Promote unresolved_probe_mode to 'deny' after zero false positives across 5 clean sessions with the unresolved-probe gate active in announce mode. Record ramp_flipped date and set unresolved_probe_ramp_complete to true on flip.
_doctrine_ledger_comment: Rollout knob for the doctrine-ledger COVERAGE floor only (PLAN_UNIQUE_CASE_COVERAGE_FLOOR Phase 4). announce = every uncovered prescriptive rule is still named loudly on every run, but an un-adjudicated corpus does not block the commit battery; deny = uncovered rules fail the run. There is deliberately NO 'off' — Phase 1.2 of this plan removed the equivalent escape hatch from coverage-manifest.mjs on the ruling that a knob disabling the primary gate IS the hole, and re-introducing one here would rebuild it. IMPORTANT ASYMMETRY: this knob governs ONLY the coverage floor. Per-rule VALIDATION failures — an enforced_by whose call site fails the three-part test, an S0/S1/S2 with no real recipient, an S3 with no adjudicator — ALWAYS fail regardless of mode. Not having adjudicated a rule yet is a backlog; claiming a rule is enforced when it is not is a false green, and a false green never ramps. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1.
doctrine_ledger_ramp_note: FLIPPED to deny 2026-07-23 on the stated criterion: coverage reached 66/66 with 0 violations. The criterion was coverage, not elapsed time — the moment the corpus was fully adjudicated the gate armed, so an unadjudicated rule can never silently reappear.
_recurrence_trial_comment: Rollout knob for the recurrence-trial closure sub-check (Cr in validate-plan-closure.mjs). Fires on Status: DONE plans via scripts/check-recurrence-trial.mjs --file <planPath>. off = check disabled (not computed); announce = check runs + reports findings but does NOT block closure (ramp default); deny = check runs + blocks closure on FAIL. Legal values: off, announce, deny. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1. Graduating incident: SUBPLAN_GUARDRAIL_RECURRENCE_TRIAL Phase 2.
recurrence_trial_ramp_note: Promote recurrence_trial_mode to 'deny' after >=10 clean sessions with zero false positives in announce mode. Record ramp_flipped date and set recurrence_trial_ramp_complete to true on flip.

interaction_coverage_ramp_note: Promote interaction_coverage_mode to 'deny' after >=10 clean sessions with zero false positives in announce mode. Record ramp_flipped date and set interaction_coverage_ramp_complete to true on flip.
_fixture_provenance_comment: Rollout knob for the fixture-provenance check (scripts/walk-coverage/check-fixture-provenance.mjs). Runs on npm run check:fixture-provenance and in pipeline:validate. Verifies every sourceQuote in kernel-oracle-fixtures.json appears verbatim (elision-aware) in its cited evidence file. off = check disabled; announce = check runs + reports findings but does not block (ramp default); deny = check runs + blocks on failure. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1 (silent quality drift — a fixture whose quote no longer matches its source passes every other check). Graduating incident: first fixtures pass shipped reconstructed quotes (0 of 6 verifiable) and was bounced — recorded in plans/pending/PLAN_FORCED_DISCOVERY_LOCATOR_EXHAUSTION.md. Landed announce per LR-069 §3.3 ramp discipline (S1: never straight to deny).
fixture_provenance_ramp_note: Promote fixture_provenance_mode to 'deny' after 10 clean sessions with zero false positives in announce mode. Record ramp_flipped date and set fixture_provenance_ramp_complete to true on flip.
_tc_fieldinventory_comment: Mode knob for the TC-has-field-inventory pre-commit gate (scripts/check-tc-has-fieldinventory.mjs). Enforces that test-case markdown content edits have a fresh paired field-inventory artifact. deny = reject the commit (exit 1); announce = print identical violation detail as a warning but allow (exit 0); off = skip evaluation entirely (exit 0). Default is DENY — fail-safe is CLOSED because this gate has been enforcing since it landed; a missing/malformed/unrecognised value falls back to deny. This knob exists for deliberate time-boxed overrides (e.g., batch restructuring) rather than as a ramp — the gate is already proven.
